method: Anonymous HTTPS .idx inventory; selected and CAPE/CIN candidate messages decoded from HTTP byte ranges with ecCodes 2.41.0. Parameter/level/step index identities are copied exactly from NOAA indexes; GRIB2 codes, units, level types and step metadata are stored where resolved. Parcel semantics remain unverified.

bulkShear0-6km.note: No direct 0-6 km bulk shear record found in wrfsfc/wrfprs index.

PWAT.level: entire atmosphere (considered as a single layer)

surfacePressure.note: No surface pressure record found in the inspected index.

MLCAPE.units: J kg**-1 (ecCodes decoded; parcel identity unverified)
MLCAPE.note: The layer record exists, but parcel semantics were not decoded. Not verified as mixed-layer CAPE.

MUCAPE.note: No message was verified as most-unstable CAPE.

MLCIN.units: J kg**-1 (ecCodes decoded; parcel identity unverified)
MLCIN.note: The layer record exists, but parcel semantics were not decoded. Not verified as mixed-layer CIN.

MUCIN.note: No CIN record was verified as most-unstable inhibition.

fixedLayerSCP.note: The formula denominator is BRN shear (40 m2 s-2). The GRIB messages contain neither that diagnostic nor precomputed 0-6 km bulk shear; pressure/native-level winds could support a later derivation.

fixedLayerSTP.formula: STP_fixed_CIN = (MLCAPE / 1000) * (bulk_shear_0-6km / 20) * (SRH_0-1km / 100) * ((2000 m - MLLCL) / 1500 m) * ((150 J kg-1 - MLCIN) / 125 J kg-1)
fixedLayerSTP.formulaSource: docs/research/mesoscale-pipeline-without-vps.md, fixed-layer CIN-limited variant, fetched from docs/mesoscale-research
fixedLayerSTP.note: The research report defines the base fixed-layer STP and a separately named CIN-limited variant. This inventory evaluates the CIN-limited version requested by issue #1759; layer CAPE/CIN candidate records exist but exact parcel identities are unverified.
